<fidel-session-viewer>

Recorded live session. A recorded live class with captions and transcript, and its Zoom chat beside it.

Who it helps:ማንን ይረዳል፦ Deaf learners and screen-reader users who missed a live class, and anyone who wants to find a moment from the chat.

Live exampleየቀጥታ ምሳሌ

This example is live: try it with the keyboard, a mouse or touch, and a screen reader.ይህ ምሳሌ ቀጥታ ነው፦ በኪቦርድ፣ በማውዝ ወይም በንክኪ፣ እና በስክሪን አንባቢ ይሞክሩት።

Code to copyየሚቀዳ ኮድ

<fidel-session-viewer src="session.mp4" captions-en="session.vtt"
                      chat="zoom-chat.txt" chat-offset="19:05" anonymize
                      lang="en"></fidel-session-viewer>

Source: player/src/session-viewer.js

Attributesመለያዎች (attributes)

Attributes of <fidel-session-viewer>
AttributeValuesDefaultMeaning
(all <fidel-player> attributes)——Passed on to the player inside.
chatURL (Zoom chat .txt)noneThe chat log saved from Zoom.
chat-offsetm:ss or h:mm:ss0:00Zoom chat times count from the meeting start. Give how much later the recording started, e.g. 19:05; messages from before are dropped.
anonymizebooleanoffShows Participant 1, 2… instead of names.
heading-level2 to 62Level of the component's heading, so it fits your page's outline.
langen, amenInterface language.

Eventsክስተቶች (events)

Events sent by <fidel-session-viewer>
Eventevent.detailWhen
fidel-session-ready{ messages }The chat is loaded; messages is the number of messages.

Events bubble and carry no personal data. Listen with addEventListener, like any DOM event.

Keyboard and screen readerኪቦርድ እና ስክሪን አንባቢ

  • Each chat message is a button: it plays the recording from that moment.
  • While the recording plays normally, new chat messages can be read aloud (a polite live region, grouped). While you jump around, nothing is announced.
  • All the player's keys work (see <fidel-player>).

Languagesቋንቋዎች

Interface in English or Amharic (lang). The chat is shown as written.

Accessibility and WCAGተደራሽነት እና WCAG

  • 1.2.2 Captions (Prerecorded): The recording has the player's captions and transcript.
  • 1.4.10 Reflow: Video and chat side by side on wide screens, one column on phones and at 200 % zoom.
  • 4.1.3 Status Messages: New chat messages are announced politely, only during normal playback.

The full WCAG 2.2 AA conformance report
